mapper.insert: insert into allow_grade (allowg_id, allowg_name, grade_id) values(#{allowgId}, #{allowgName}, #{gradeId})
mapper.select: select allowg_id, allowg_name , ag.grade_id, grade_name, grade_level from allow_grade ag left join grade g on ag.grade_id = ag.grade_id where allowg_id=#{allowgId}
